description: This file defines a class for running Pylint code quality tests within an Odoo module, including executing Pylint on Python files in a given directory and processing the results.

classes.name: quality_test
classes.description: A class that performs Pylint code quality checks on Python files within a specified module directory.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the quality_test class with default parameters and descriptive attributes.

methods.name: run_test
methods.description: Executes Pylint on Python files in the provided module path, parses results, and generates a report.

methods.name: get_result
methods.description: Formats the Pylint results into a table for display.
